Mechanical stability of custom-made implants: Numerical study of anatomical device and low elastic Young's modulus alloy.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Background only simulation_case
P Didier, B Piotrowski, M Fischer, P Laheurte Materials science & engineering. C, Materials for biological applications 2017-05-01 10.1016/j.msec.2016.12.031
单位: Laboratoire d'Etude des Microstructures et de Mécanique des Matériaux LEM3 UMR CNRS 7239, Arts et Métiers ParisTech Campus de Metz, Université de Lorraine, Ile de Saulcy, F-57078 Metz-Cedex 01, France
通讯: P Didier @ Laboratoire d'Etude des Microstructures et de Mécanique des Matériaux LEM3 UMR CNRS 7239, Arts et Métiers ParisTech Camp
相关性: 该论文通过数值模拟研究了低弹性模量合金Ti-26Nb对植入物-骨应力分布的影响，但缺乏实验验证和增材制造相关测试。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no porous structure, and no fatigue evaluation.
动机· 研究解剖型和标准型植入物对骨应力分布的影响及低弹性模量合金的改善效果。
方法· 使用有限元分析比较两种几何形状和两种合金（Ti-6Al-4V和Ti-26Nb）的应力分布。
结果· Ti-26Nb合金的解剖型植入物能显著改善骨-植入物力学兼容性。
验证· 仅为数值模拟，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare stress distribution in bone for standard vs anatomical custom-made implants and evaluate the benefit of low Young's modulus alloy Ti-26Nb.
Method· Finite element analysis of two implant geometries and two biocompatible alloys (Ti-6Al-4V and Ti-26Nb) was performed.
Result· Anatomical implants made of Ti-26Nb significantly improved mechanical compatibility with bone compared to standard Ti-6Al-4V implants.
Validation· Numerical simulation without experimental validation.

Jingdong Lin, Li Huang, Zhou Hongbo 2017-05-01 10.1109/ccdc.2017.7978140
单位: Collage of Automation, Chongqing University, Chongqing, China
通讯: Jingdong Lin @ Collage of Automation, Chongqing University, Chongqing, China
相关性: 该论文将高斯过程回归用于板料成形缺陷预测，方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
边界: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on sheet metal forming defects.
动机· 准确预测板料成形缺陷以提高成形质量。
方法· 采用高斯过程回归构建代理模型，替代有限元仿真。
结果· GPR方法比支持向量机和响应面法更准确有效。
验证· 通过仪表板拉深案例验证预测精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Accurate prediction of forming defects is critical for improving sheet metal forming quality.
Method· A Gaussian process regression surrogate model is built from finite element simulations to predict fracture and wrinkle defects.
Result· The GPR approach outperforms support vector machines and conventional response surface methods in prediction accuracy.
Validation· The method is validated on a dashboard drawing case using forming limit diagrams to quantify defects.

Motivation· To efficiently solve nonlinear stochastic optimal control problems with uncertainty quantification.
Method· A hybrid algorithm combining Legendre Pseudospectral Method for deterministic control and generalized Polynomial Chaos for stochastic representation.
Result· The hybrid method achieves high accuracy in solving stochastic optimal control problems and enables uncertainty propagation.
Validation· Validated on a nonlinear stochastic optimal control benchmark problem.

Bayesian uncertainty quantification and sparse Bayesian learning for model updating in SHM

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
James L. Beck, Young Huang 2017-05-01 10.5592/co/bshm2017.2.2
单位: Professor of Engineering and Applied Science, California Institute of Technology, 1200 E California Blvd, Pasadena, 91125, USA
通讯: James L. Beck @ Professor of Engineering and Applied Science, California Institute of Technology, 1200 E California Blvd, Pasadena, 9112
相关性: 该论文的贝叶斯不确定性量化与稀疏学习方法可迁移至植入物力学代理模型的不确定性量化与约束优化。
边界: This paper focuses on structural health monitoring (vibration-based damage detection) rather than implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or design optimization.
动机· 利用振动监测数据更新结构模型，检测局部刚度损失。
方法· 采用贝叶斯方法量化模型不确定性，并引入稀疏贝叶斯学习推断空间稀疏的刚度折减。
结果· 贝叶斯奥卡姆剃刀自动平衡数据拟合与模型复杂度，避免过拟合。
验证· 通过数值算例验证稀疏贝叶斯学习在结构健康监测中的有效性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To detect and quantify localized stiffness losses in instrumented structures via vibration-based model updating.
Method· A Bayesian framework is employed to quantify model uncertainty, and sparse Bayesian learning is used to infer spatially-sparse substructural stiffness reductions, automatically applying an Ockham razor.
Result· The Bayesian Ockham razor trades off data-fit and model complexity, preventing overfitting and enabling robust damage identification.
Validation· Illustrative numerical simulations validate the capability of the sparse Bayesian learning algorithms for structural health monitoring.

Validation· Experimental imaging validation of jet dynamics without computational modeling.

Motivation· To investigate whether ultraviolet-mediated photofunctionalisation enhances osseointegration of Ti6Al4V implants as it does for pure titanium.

Teaching students how to think like an immunologist: flipping a classroom without flipping out.

Kirstin Parkin The Journal of Immunology 2017-05-01 10.4049/jimmunol.198.supp.128.7
单位: Michigan State Univ
通讯: Kirstin Parkin @ Michigan State Univ
相关性: 该论文是关于免疫学教学方法的，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
边界: This paper is about immunology education, not about surrogate modeling, FEA, uncertainty quantification, or implant design.
动机· 将传统免疫学课程转为团队学习环境，培养学生科学思维。
方法· 采用在线形成性评估、课堂团队活动和Top Hat互动问题。
结果· 学生在形成性评估中的简答题表现提升，低出勤率学生得分最低。
验证· 通过学生反馈和考试成绩评估教学效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To transform a traditional lecture-based immunology course into a team-based learning environment that teaches students to think like scientists.
Method· Implemented online formative assessments, in-class team activities, and Top Hat response questions to engage students.
Result· Student performance on short-answer questions improved over the semester, and low attendance correlated with lower scores.
Validation· Evaluated through student feedback and exam performance.

Validation· Tribocorrosion tests with OCP measurements and FEG-SEM/EDS analysis of worn surfaces.

动机· 评估全髋关节置换术后持续静脉输注羟考酮的镇痛效果和安全性。

Motivation· To evaluate the analgesic efficacy and safety of continuous intravenous oxycodone infusion combined with ketoprofen after total hip arthroplasty.

Result· Oxycodone at 2 mg/h provided satisfactory analgesia without rescue analgesics in all nine patients; 1 mg/h was effective in three out of five patients.
Validation· Clinical observation and adverse event recording during the first 24 hours after surgery.

Method· Prospective cohort study of 29 patients with at least 24 months follow-up, using WOMAC and RAND-36 surveys.

Validation· Clinical outcomes with infection resolution rate of 86% and HRQL scores at 24 months.

Motivation· To assess the reliability of measuring acetabular component position from postoperative radiographs using a basic diagnostic imaging software.
Method· Lewinnek's method was applied to 69 postoperative AP radiographs of primary THA patients using InteleViewer software.
Result· Excellent intra- and inter-observer reliability (ICC >0.93) was achieved for both inclination and anteversion measurements.
Validation· Clinical validation through intra- and inter-observer reliability analysis on patient radiographs.

Motivation· To evaluate the outcome of staged hip arthroscopy and periacetabular osteotomy in treating hip dysplasia with labral tear.

Motivation· To investigate the role of SIRT1 in the inflammatory response induced by metal nanoparticles in aseptic loosening after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· In vitro stimulation of macrophages with metal nanoparticles and in vivo osteolysis model, combined with pharmacological activation of SIRT1 using resveratrol.
Result· SIRT1 downregulation promotes inflammatory cytokine expression, and SIRT1 activation reduces particle-induced osteolysis.
Validation· In vitro cell assays and in vivo mouse calvarial osteolysis model.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate early outcomes of isolated acetabular revision using alumina-on-alumina bearings without a metal sleeve on the retained femoral stem.
Method· Retrospective review of 22 patients (23 hips) who underwent revision from metal-on-polyethylene to alumina-on-alumina bearings, with clinical and radiographic evaluation.
Result· Significant improvement in Harris Hip Score, WOMAC, and VAS pain score at mean 3-year follow-up, with low complication rates.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with standardized outcome scores and radiographic assessment.
